title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering.

explain: Nvidia said it will put $3 billion into new shares Meta is selling, announced alongside a wider deal to expand their work on Meta's Muse AI models and Meta's use of Nvidia hardware. The press release says Nvidia 'will invest' but gives no closing date.
